landing.heroSub: Enter your energy usage, location, and budget — Solarah calculates the perfect PV system for your home. No engineer visit needed. No guesswork. Anywhere in the world.
landing.howItWorksSub: Solarah guides you through a short assessment, then generates a complete solar design report.
landing.step1Desc: Enter your monthly bill, key appliances, and location. We pull real solar irradiance data for your coordinates automatically.
landing.step2Desc: Our engine calculates the optimal panel count, inverter rating, and battery capacity for your specific usage and sun hours.
landing.step3Desc: Download a professional PDF with system specs, recommended products, savings forecast, and a full ROI timeline.
landing.step4Desc: Optionally connect with a certified partner engineer for a virtual consultation — wherever you are in the world.
landing.quote: From bill to blueprint in under three minutes — no site visit required.
landing.featuresSub: Built for homeowners and businesses worldwide who want solar without the complexity.
landing.feat1Desc: Uses real solar irradiance data for your exact coordinates — accurate anywhere on Earth.
landing.feat2Desc: Top-rated panels, inverters, and batteries with direct purchase links to verified suppliers.
landing.feat3Desc: See your payback period and 25-year savings tailored to local electricity rates.
landing.feat4Desc: A shareable, professional document you can send to your family, bank, or installer.
landing.feat5Desc: Book a certified engineer for a video call review of your system — no travel needed.
landing.feat6Desc: Available in multiple languages so anyone, anywhere can use Solarah in their own tongue.
